messages:
Priya: Heads-up — did an int8 onboarding run for aurora7b on the aurora-canary pool. Throughput looked good (~2.5x tokens/sec) but we saw quality regressions on multi-turn convo prompts >800 tokens. No hard OOMs, but memory fragmentation steady increase across long sessions. Posting core numbers and eval link.

Priya: perf snapshot: p50=42ms, p95=210ms, tokens/sec=2450, mem_rss=12.2GB, mem_frag_trend=+6% per hour. Link: https://dash.redwood/internal/evals/aurora7b/int8/176834

Jordan: can you paste the failing example ids or a diff? is it deterministic w/ seed?

Priya: quick diffs attached in dashboard. Not deterministic but shows higher entropy hallucinations on follow-up QA and missed references to prior turns. bench-bot ran auto-evals.

bench-bot: autotest: pass_rate=87%, baseline=open-7b-int8=94%, delta=-7%. Top buckets: follow-up_qa (-12%), instruction_following (-9%).

Alex: my hypothesis: quantization + our aggressive prefetch + larger default max_new_tokens (128) is causing more KV eviction / stale context in some code paths. Two quick asks: 1) try lowering max_new_tokens default to 64 for chat endpoints on canary; 2) disable streaming prefetch to force sequential KV population.

Sam: also saw a mem frag pattern on small long-lived sessions. Workarounds we used before: increase runtime slot_reserve (e.g., 1.15) and reduce continuous batch size to 2 for canary. Also run jemalloc background purge after N requests.

Priya: trying a config patch now. Patch:
```
runtime:
  batch_max_tokens: 4096
  batch_size: 2
  max_new_tokens_default: 64
  prefetch: false
  slot_reserve: 1.15
```
Applying to aurora-canary with canary_pct=5. Will run the 5k conv A/B (int8 vs int8+patch) and human eval on worst buckets. @Jordan @Alex @Sam watching.

Evan: if quality still lags, consider fallback policy to model-aurora-int4 (lower perf but sometimes better recency) or route long-context sessions to a higher-precision variant.

Jordan: 20m in — preliminary results: pass_rate bumped to 92.8%, p95 increased ~30ms but still within SLO. mem_frag trend flattened. No OOMs so far. Will let run 2 hours.

Priya: great — thanks. If stable at 2h, roll to 25% and then bump defaults if human evals look good. :thumbsup:
